description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeStackedSeries' that processes raw cost aggregate data into a format suitable for visualization in Recharts, specifically for creating stacked series with zero-filled categories. It accepts an array of records and optional configuration parameters, returning structured data with categories and services for charting.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a structured dataset with categories and services, filling missing values with zeros to support stacked visualization.
